comment: Shared spec for the #5572 context guard. BOTH implementations (hooks/lib/handoff.mjs guardContextTokens, desktop/src-tauri ContextGuard) must pass every case — one manifest so they cannot drift. rows = assistant usage-token sums in transcript order; expect = the guarded reading (null = no reading). Rule: report the last row unless it falls below 40% of the session max — then report the recent maximum (transient artifact) unless the last FIVE rows all sit below the floor (sustained new level: accept and re-baseline). A row "compact" is a compaction (a compact_boundary transcript row): the guard starts over, so the first reading after it counts at once, and none at all reads as no reading.
